meta.title: micasaestuya · a place to stay in exchange for helping out
meta.description: Accommodation and meals in exchange for a few hours of help a day. Free, in Cuba and the Dominican Republic.

info_pages.draft_notice: Draft pending legal review. It describes how micasaestuya works today, but no specialist has reviewed it yet.

sections.title: What micasaestuya is
paragraphs: A platform that connects people who offer a place to stay and meals with people willing to help out a few hours a day in return: cooking, gardening, cleaning, looking after children or animals, maintenance…
No money changes hands between host and traveler: the exchange is a place to stay and meals for help.

sections.title: Where
paragraphs: We're starting in Cuba and the Dominican Republic, aiming to grow to any country.

sections.title: Free, for real
paragraphs: No commission, no fee, no subscription. The project runs on voluntary donations that only cover development and hosting.
The code is open source and lives on GitHub.

sections.title: We only put you in touch
paragraphs: Host and traveler agree on the arrangement (dates, hours, conditions) directly, on WhatsApp or however you prefer. micasaestuya doesn't mediate that agreement, doesn't verify identities and doesn't guarantee what happens during the stay.

sections.title: How much does it cost?
paragraphs: Nothing. Neither for hosts nor for travelers.

sections.title: Do I need an account to list my place?
paragraphs: You can fill in the whole form without one. We only ask you to log in or sign up when you press “Publish my place”.

sections.title: How do I contact a host?
paragraphs: On WhatsApp, with the number the host gives in their listing. From there you talk directly.

sections.title: Do you verify hosts or travelers?
paragraphs: No. We have no way to check identities or guarantee what's published. Talk things through first, on a video call if you can, and use common sense.

sections.title: Is there a minimum age?
paragraphs: Yes: 18.

sections.title: Which countries does it work in?
paragraphs: For now, Cuba and the Dominican Republic.

sections.title: How do you keep going if it's free?
paragraphs: With voluntary donations, used only to cover development and hosting.

sections.title: What data we keep
paragraphs: If you create an account: your first name, last name, email and password. The password is stored encrypted, never in plain text.

If you list a place: what you write in the form (title, region, description, tasks, capacity and your WhatsApp number). All of it will be visible to anyone who sees your listing: the number is there precisely so people can message you.
The photos you add to the form are uploaded when you publish and will be visible to anyone who sees your listing.

sections.title: What we keep in your browser
paragraphs: Your session, language, light or dark theme, the form draft and its photos. The details are in the cookie policy.

sections.title: Who it's shared with
paragraphs: Nobody, for commercial purposes. To run, we use these services: Netlify (serves the website), Render (serves the API), MongoDB Atlas (stores accounts), Upstash (stores the list of regions, no personal data), Cloudflare R2 (stores the photos of the listings) and Sentry (records errors and session replays so we can reproduce bugs; it doesn't record what you type into fields).

sections.title: Your rights
paragraphs: You can ask us to see, correct or delete your data, and to delete your account. {contact}

sections.title: Only what's needed
paragraphs: We don't use advertising or third-party tracking cookies. What's stored in your browser is there for the site to work.

sections.title: Cookies
paragraphs: access-token: keeps you logged in. It lasts a year, unless you log in without ticking “Remember me”: then it lasts until you close the browser.
i18n_redirected: remembers your country and language.

sections.title: Other browser storage
paragraphs: nuxt-color-mode (localStorage): light or dark theme.
listing-draft (localStorage) and the “micasaestuya” IndexedDB database: your listing draft and its photos, so they aren't lost if you reload. They're deleted when you publish.
Sentry stores a session identifier to group the errors from a single visit.

sections.title: What the service is
paragraphs: micasaestuya is a free board where hosts list places to stay and travelers find them. It only puts you in touch.

sections.title: What we don't do
paragraphs: We're not a party to the agreement between host and traveler, we don't mediate it and we don't guarantee it.
We don't verify identities or check that what's published is true.
We're not responsible for what happens during a stay.

sections.title: What we ask
paragraphs: Be at least 18 years old.
Publish truthful information about your place and what you ask in return.
Treat others with respect. We may remove false, illegal or offensive content and close the accounts that publish it.
